description: Get or set Do Not Disturb / Focus mode. The get action is best-effort: it reads the Focus state file in ~/Library/DoNotDisturb, which may be unreadable to the server process, and returns status "unknown" when that file cannot be read or parsed. The set action runs a shortcut named "Set Focus" from the Shortcuts library and passes {"mode": <mode>, "enabled": <enabled>} to it as JSON input. That shortcut is not built in: create it so it reads this input (e.g. with Get Dictionary from Input) and applies mode and enabled with the Set Focus action. Mode names must exactly match configured Focus names (e.g. "Do Not Disturb", "Work", "Personal").

action.description: get — query current Focus status (best-effort); set — enable or disable a Focus mode.

enabled.description: For action=set: true=enable the mode, false=disable it. Defaults to true.

mode.description: Focus mode name for action=set, e.g. "Do Not Disturb", "Work". Must match a configured Focus name exactly, including case.

name: macos_manage_focus

enabled.description: The requested state sent to the shortcut: true to turn the mode on, false to turn it off. Present for action=set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `shortcuts_unavailable`: The shortcuts CLI is missing, or the Shortcuts library has no shortcut named "Set Focus". `shortcut_failed`: The "Set Focus" shortcut ran and exited with an error; the message carries its error text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mode.description: For action=get: the active Focus mode, or null when inactive or unknown. For action=set: the requested mode, as sent to the shortcut.

reason.description: Explanation when status is "unknown". Present for action=get.

status.description: Current Focus status. Present for action=get. "unknown" when the Focus state file could not be read or parsed.

success.description: True when the "Set Focus" shortcut finished without error. The Focus state is not read back. Present for action=set.

title: Manage macOS Focus Mode
